Select IC50 activity values for compounds tested against human leucine-rich repeat serine/threonine-protein kinase (CHEMBL1075104). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL1075104 and standard_type IC50. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
